# Load the raw counts from perirenal depot to build the Seurat obj
fat1_raw <- Read10X(paste0(input_path, "fat_1"))
# Initialize the Seurat object with the raw (non-normalized data)
perirenal <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = fat1_raw, project = "perirenal", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200) # min.cells -> it tells seurat to include a gene only if it is detected in at least 3 different cells. 
                                                                                                        # min.features -> It tells Seurat to include a cell only if it has at least 200 unique genes within it.
perirenal

# DoubletFinder on fat_!
# Pre-processing for the tool
perirenal_filtered <- NormalizeData(perirenal_filtered)
perirenal_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(perirenal_filtered)
perirenal_filtered <- ScaleData(perirenal_filtered)
perirenal_filtered <- RunPCA(perirenal_filtered)
perirenal_filtered <- RunUMAP(perirenal_filtered, dims = 1:20)


# Find pK (Optimal neighborhood size)
sweep.res <- paramSweep(perirenal_filtered, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
best.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Predict Doublets
# Adjust 0.04 (4%) based on your expected doublet rate (approx 0.8% per 1000 cells)
nExp_poi <- round(0.126 * nrow(perirenal_filtered@meta.data))  # We choose this percentage because we have more than 20,000 cells

perirenal_filtered <- doubletFinder(perirenal_filtered, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = best.pk, nExp = nExp_poi, sct = FALSE)

# Extract the column name (it changes based on parameters)
classification_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(perirenal_filtered@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# CREATE THE FINAL SINGLET OBJECT
fat1_singlets <- subset(perirenal_filtered, cells = rownames(perirenal_filtered@meta.data)[perirenal_filtered@meta.data[, classification_col] == "Singlet"])

# DoubletFinder on fat_!
# Pre-processing for the tool
subcut_filtered <- NormalizeData(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- FindVariableFeatures(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- ScaleData(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- RunPCA(subcut_filtered)
subcut_filtered <- RunUMAP(subcut_filtered, dims = 1:20)


# Find pK (Optimal neighborhood size)
sweep.res <- paramSweep(subcut_filtered, PCs = 1:20, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
best.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Predict Doublets
# Adjust 0.04 (4%) based on your expected doublet rate (approx 0.8% per 1000 cells)
nExp_poi <- round(0.105 * nrow(subcut_filtered@meta.data))  # We choose this percentage because we have more than 20,000 cells

subcut_filtered <- doubletFinder(subcut_filtered, PCs = 1:20, pN = 0.25, pK = best.pk, nExp = nExp_poi, sct = FALSE)

# Extract the column name (it changes based on parameters)
classification_col <- grep("DF.classifications", colnames(subcut_filtered@meta.data), value = TRUE)

# CREATE THE FINAL SINGLET OBJECT
fat2_singlets <- subset(subcut_filtered, cells = rownames(subcut_filtered@meta.data)[subcut_filtered@meta.data[, classification_col] == "Singlet"])

# Find pK (Optimal neighborhood size)

sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)
best.pk <- as.numeric(as.character(bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]))

# Predict Doublets

# Extract the column name (it changes based on parameters)

# CREATE THE FINAL SINGLET OBJECT
fat3_singlets <- subset(omental_filtered, cells = rownames(omental_filtered@meta.data)[omental_filtered@meta.data[, classification_col] == "Singlet"])

# Extract metadata
meta <- fat_merged@meta.data

# Create the 'final_donor' column based on the batch and vireo donor_id
# Replace 'batch_column' with the actual name of your batch/location column
meta <- meta %>%
  mutate(final_donor = case_when(
    orig.ident == "perirenal" ~ map_fat1[donor_id],
    orig.ident == "subcutaneous" ~ map_fat2[donor_id],
    orig.ident == "omental" ~ map_fat3[donor_id],
    TRUE ~ donor_id # Keeps 'doublet' or 'unassigned' labels as they are
  ))

# Re-assign to Seurat object
fat_merged@meta.data <- meta
